meta.source: MoSPI, NSS 80 Comprehensive Modular Survey: Education
meta.base: CMSE April–June 2025, school spending and coaching separate
meta.revisionPolicy: These published administrative counts and survey estimates may be revised by the agency; changed responses are archived before rebaking.
meta.coverage: Average expenditure (₹) per reported student on school expenditure during the current academic year by type of school for each level of enrolment: all published cross-tabs; level of enrollment, sector, state, type of school
meta.note: Complete observed row grain from data/raw/schools/cmse-36.json. No Cartesian expansion or averaging of state ratios. Survey estimates describe currently enrolled students; state estimates require sample-size/RSE caution. Spending covers the current academic year; coaching is separate from school spending. Survey totals must not be extrapolated into population counts.
